title: Acadia Healthcare Company, Inc. 8-K Filing
summary: Acadia Healthcare Company announced the resignation of Chief Financial Officer Todd Young, effective April 30, 2026, and the appointment of David M. Duckworth as Interim CFO effective May 1, 2026. Duckworth previously served as Acadia's CFO from July 2012 to July 2023.
key_points: Todd Young resigned as CFO effective April 30, 2026
David M. Duckworth appointed Interim CFO effective May 1, 2026
Duckworth eligible for quarterly cash bonus of $125,000 per quarter
Severance provision of $350,000 if terminated in connection with hiring of permanent CFO
Employment agreement term runs from April 27, 2026 through May 1, 2027
